neutral_brief: Trust administration advice. Prepare for the trustee's meeting on 23 October 2026. Establish the expressly named beneficiaries and which provisions are still in force from the file as it stood at 09:00 that day.

sources.transmission: Priya Sen recorded the briefing purpose and cut-off in the advice file on 20 October 2026.
Trustee Jonah Reed retained the executed instrument and supplied its relevant extract on 19 October 2026.
Tess Calder signed the instrument on 8 October 2026, delivered it to Jonah Reed, and he supplied a copy on 19 October 2026.
